subject: Security intake: adaptive log-sampling and privilege-separation clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex@orchidlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@orchidlabs.com
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ intake: log sampling window & separation of admin duties

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking our intake request — Orchid is working through the CAIQ and had two specific clarifying questions before the call:

1) Log sampling: we request a 24h contiguous sample of production access logs and system service logs. Can Redwood provide a JSONL sample covering a rolling 24-hour window, anonymized, with removed PII? If yes, what is the earliest turnaround to produce a redacted sample?

2) Privilege separation: our SecOps team needs a short write-up of how Redwood enforces separation between infra/admin roles and application-level access (who can export logs, who can decrypt backups). A short diagram or bullet list will suffice for our initial review.

Can we schedule a 30‑minute call this week to walk through these two items and confirm owners? Ideally Wed or Thu morning PST. Please include whoever owns logging & backups.

Attachments: orchid_initial_scope.pdf (scoping doc)

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Security Engineer, Orchid Labs
alex@orchidlabs.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: log sampling window & separation of admin duties

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask and the sample scope. We can produce an anonymized JSONL log sample and a short privilege-separation summary. Proposed plan:

- 30m call to triage: Thursday 2026-09-28 10:00–10:30 PT (Irene will join for logging/export details).
- Deliverables after call: anonymized 24h log sample (redacted) and a 1‑page privilege separation diagram + roles/responsibilities list. Target delivery: Fri 2026-09-29 EOD PT.

Irene, Marissa — can you confirm availability for the slot and whether we should include any additional engineers (backup: system-ops@redwood.com)?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@orchidlabs.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Notes: intake call — log sample & privilege separation (summary)

On Thu, Sep 28, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT, Alex Romero <alex@orchidlabs.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the time — quick notes and action items below.

Call attendees:
- Alex Romero (Orchid Labs, Security)
- Hannah Schmitt (Redwood, Director Security Partnerships)
- Irene Choi (Redwood, Compliance Engineer)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood, Customer Success)

Discussion summary:
- Log sampling: Iris (Irene) walked through Redwood’s log architecture (control plane events, inference request logs, system-daemon events). We confirmed fields that will be present in the sample: timestamp, request_id, model_id, truncated_user_input_hash, action (create/stream/close), source_region, node_id. No raw prompts or user-provided content will be included.

- Redaction approach: PII fields will be replaced with stable hashed tokens (sha256 prefix) and IPs will be mapped to /24 buckets. We will remove message text and sensitive headers.

- Delivery time: Iris committed to delivering a 24‑hour anonymized sample by Fri 2026-09-29 18:00 PT.

- Privilege separation: Hannah reviewed the high-level controls:
  * Role tiers: Platform Admins (infra ops), Service Owners (model/runtime ops), Support (read-only access to aggregated logs), Security (audit role).
  * Exports: Only Platform Admins + Security can request raw exports; exports require two-step approval for cross-account requests.
  * Backup decryption keys: Managed in customer KMS integrations or Redwood KMS (HSM-backed). Key access is limited to a separate key-ops role; Service Owners cannot decrypt backups.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Irene: produce anonymized 24h JSONL log sample (log-sample-24h.jsonl), include README with redaction rules — Due: 2026-09-29 18:00 PT.
- Hannah: prepare 1‑page privilege separation diagram and bullet list for CAIQ — Due: 2026-09-29 18:00 PT.
- Marissa: upload artifacts to shared Drive folder and send link to Orchid — Due: 2026-09-29 20:00 PT.

Attachments referenced on call: sys-arch-diagram.pdf (internal), draft CAIQ mapping (we will attach redwood_caiq_answers_v0.9.xlsx post-call).

Please reply if I missed anything. If the delivery ETA looks tight for Orchid, tell us which item you'd like to reprioritize.

Regards,
Hannah

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@orchidlabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notes: intake call — log sample & privilege separation (summary)
